name: Láeg

attributes.attribute: died to save his master from a spear

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Láeg, also written Laeg or Loeg, drove the chariot of the hero Cuchulainn. He served the great hero of Ulster. Láeg saved his master by taking a spear that was aimed at him. He gave his life for his lord.

okr.objective: Record the chariot-driver Laeg and his service to Cuchulainn.
key_results: Laeg drove the chariot of Cuchulainn
